interfaces.common: Complete root propagation, finite root recognition and primitive-square proofs from N011 root_parameters; these classical specializations are acquired in full.
interfaces.n6: The accepted N011 six-dimensional Laurent identities are reused without the old primitive-parameter restriction; choose v and normalize the central square.
interfaces.negative_dimensions: Complete acquired H_n(q) symmetric-square obstruction for n2,3,4.
interfaces.polytopes: Standard rank-three intersection criterion and regular-polytope correspondence retained from the source.
interfaces.prime_certificate: The 131-letter identity uses only direct integer matrix multiplication modulo3; no GAP group order or search completeness is required.
interfaces.uniform_dimensions: Eight abstract labels prove all n>=8; one five-dimensional invariant subspace proves monomial exclusion and quotient descent for all n>=5.
